summary: ProQR Therapeutics N.V. filed a Form 424B5 prospectus to register the resale of up to 3,030,303 ordinary shares by a selling shareholder. The shares were issued in a prior private placement under a Share Purchase Agreement dated April 6, 2026. ProQR is not selling any shares and will not receive any proceeds. The registration is a regulatory requirement for the selling shareholder's potential future sales. On July 2, 2026, the closing price was $1.81 per share. This is a routine resale registration and does not constitute an acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation event.
